title: User service units installed and resource-capped automatically
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Render and install systemd/launchd/Windows user units with sane resource caps as part of install. Integration test zc_service_units.rs.
